answer_1.quote: AQFS aims to summarize all pertinent information from the documents with in-line citations to make the summary attributable.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form summaries with in-line citation markers referencing source documents.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics to evaluate the utility of the summaries: Length, Self-BLEU, Claim precision, Claim recall, Claim F1, AIS, ACS, Citation precision, Citation recall, Citation F1.
